weaponTypes.name: Pistol
weaponTypes.description: Sidearm-class weapons; fast swap, moderate damage, common as a backup slot.

weaponTypes.name: Submachine Gun (SMG)
weaponTypes.description: High fire-rate, close-range weapons with fast reloads.

weaponTypes.name: Assault Rifle
weaponTypes.description: Balanced mid-range weapons, the most versatile weapon class.

weaponTypes.name: Shotgun
weaponTypes.description: Multi-pellet, high burst-damage weapons for close range.

weaponTypes.name: Sniper Rifle
weaponTypes.description: High single-shot damage, long range, weakspot-focused.

weaponTypes.name: Light Machine Gun (LMG)
weaponTypes.description: Large magazines and sustained fire, pairs well with the Fast Gunner effect.

weaponTypes.name: Bow / Crossbow
weaponTypes.description: Silent, high per-shot damage ranged weapons, often crit-focused.

weaponTypes.name: Heavy Weapon
weaponTypes.description: Grenade/rocket launchers and other explosive/AoE weapons.

weaponTypes.name: Melee Weapon
weaponTypes.description: Close-quarters weapons such as batons, blades, axes and pikes.

note: Once Human's full arsenal spans 126+ individual weapons (per oncehumandb.com) once every named legendary variant of each base chassis (DE.50, R500, MPS5/7, KV-SBR, SOCR, KAM, DB12/DBSG/ACS12, AWS.338, SN700, HAMR, MG4, KVD, etc.) is counted separately. The list above (72 entries) is a broad, sourced cross-section across all 9 weapon categories and every rarity tier — base chassis plus their notable named variants — rather than a literal enumeration of all 126+ entries; most of the gap is additional named legendary/epic skins of the same chassis already listed. One category is NOT under-represented by omission: Heavy Weapons genuinely only has a couple of carried options (MGL, RPG7 Rocket Launcher) in the live game — Gatling Cannons and plasma-round turrets are deployable structures, not carried weapons, so they are catalogued under Blueprints → Defense instead.
